flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/PS/{form/PSForm,form/PSDetails,form/PSSummary,list/PSList,page/PS,page/PSView}.tsx, pages/NoticeSearch/hook/{ApplyOperationAction.tsx,useBatchOperation.ts}, context/OptionsContext.tsx, utils/{mapping,validation}/PS/PS.ts, utils/constant.ts. ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_creation/core/SuspensionProcessingController (staff-apply-suspension, staff-revive-suspension, staff-check-suspension-eligibility), core/helpers/{PermanentSuspensionHelper,SuspensionBaseHelper,SuspensionProcessingHelper,PermanentRevivalHelper,RevivalBaseHelper}, crud/ocmsizdb/suspendednotice/SuspendedNotice, api-authorization.properties (OCMS_APPLY_PS). ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not used by this staff PS flow
note: Status in stories.json is 'Fully paid'; there is no OCMS flow deck. The summary lives in the 'Summary' tab of the PS form (notice list with current suspension type and reason columns, plus the chosen code - description and remarks). The prompt for overwriting an existing PS is only a yellow banner and a row highlight; the text 'Do you wish to manually override the existing Permanent Suspension?' (ApplyOperationAction.tsx:42-44) is defined but not used, and the 'Manually Override PS' button is commented out (ApplyOperationAction.tsx:353-381). How the officer reaches the Summary tab is judged in OCMS18.7. No maintenance ticket changes the verdict.
recommendation: Partial claim: the notice summary with code and remarks and the OK/cancel confirmation exist; the overwrite prompt is only an information banner, not a prompt that mentions overwriting

steps.step: OCMS shows a summary of the selected notices with key details (stage, current suspension type and reason, payment status, amount)
steps.detail: The 'Summary' tab renders PSList in SUMMARY mode (readonly) with columns notice no, notice type, offence place, rule code, vehicle no, processing stage, next processing stage, suspension_type, suspension_reason, due date of revival, payment status and amount payable (PSList.tsx:112-144). Notice data is re-fetched from the validoffencenoticelist endpoint (PS.tsx:30-65).

steps.step: The summary shows the permanent suspension details to be applied (suspension code, reason/remarks)
steps.detail: PSSummary shows 'code - description' from suspension_code_data (PSSummary.tsx:42-47, 60-65) and the remarks field from the form (PSSummary.tsx:67-71), below the notice list in the Summary tab (PSForm.tsx:381). The description text comes from the suspension reason DB: its content cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: OCMS prompts when notices already have a permanent suspension that will be overwritten
steps.detail: Notice rows with suspensionType PS get class bg-warning-subtle and a yellow banner 'Notice(s) highlighted have existing Permanent Suspension (PS).' shows in the form and Summary tabs (PSList.tsx:66-90). The banner only informs, does not mention overwriting, and needs no separate click. The confirmation modal stays generic (PSForm.tsx:85-90). The dedicated prompt 'Do you wish to manually override the existing Permanent Suspension?' (ApplyOperationAction.tsx:42-44) is not called anywhere and the 'Manually Override PS' button is commented out (ApplyOperationAction.tsx:353-381).

steps.step: The officer confirms (OK) to apply the permanent suspension, or cancels
steps.detail: The 'PS Confirmation' ModalConfirm has an OK action (handleComModalOk -> onSubmit, which calls apply) and a close that only hides the modal without calling the API (PSForm.tsx:260-263, 275-283).
